title: Before the Contract Starts | Procurement Journey

logical_structure.title: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: This guidance covers the period after preferred bidder identification / intention to award , up to Go-Live / Day 1 of service delivery .
It ensures the contract is set up for successful performance, compliance, and risk management from the start.
Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: For medium and high-risk contracts, the preparation before the contract begins is critical. The work will already have been started when the commodity strategy and tender documents were prepared and this phase will build upon that.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Ensure a smooth and controlled mobilisation
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Confirm the supplier fully understands the specification, Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and obligations
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Establish governance, communication channels, and performance expectations
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Finalise risk controls, data requirements, and compliance arrangements
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Ensure the contract manager has everything needed to manage performance from Day 1
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Document evidence for audit and procurement governance
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Early clarity reduces operational risk, improves supplier performance, and creates the foundations for a strong commercial relationship.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management
Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Proportionate to risk – higher-risk contracts require more robust planning and documentation.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Collaboration – early engagement with the supplier sets the tone for partnership working.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Transparency and documentation – all agreements should be minuted and filed.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Service continuity – the mobilisation plan must minimise disruption to service users.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management

content_blocks.text: Governance first – roles, responsibilities, and decision pathways must be agreed before work starts.
heading_path: Purpose of Pre-Contract Contract and Supplier Management
